state: A language draft has no implemented compiler or runtime compatibility constraint. Its read policy fields use selector paths syntactically, but nested value-leaf authorization is undefined. Matching policies union fields; a derived value requires readable data dependencies, and pure derives inherit viewer authority. An associated delivery has immutable id and mutable status/result/error; current policy requires its containing field grant plus result/error/lifetime checks. Reads fence receipt revision without changing the domain row version. Example source: Item.notification:delivery(Mail.send)?; derive Item.notice_state:DeliveryResult.status? = row.notification?.status. Recipient policy is read=authenticated where=row.service!=null and recipient(actor,row.service) fields=service,recipient,kind,state,notice_state,completed,created. The recipient predicate checks the assigned verified contact, matching account and active unarchived customer/contact. Staff has a separate full Item grant and current workplace gate. Thus the status derive currently lacks a readable dependency. The desired target uses delivery(c,handle), whose current text does not specify field-origin provenance or partial leaf grants. Required outcome: recipient sees current notice status or a no-request state, never receipt identity/result/error/request text; revoked recipients immediately lose visibility. Staff keeps operational detail. Mail business completion still correlates current association id and only moves received to notified on succeeded with a result. Other transport progress must not alter custody. Existing scope=authority read operations explicitly disclose typed results under authored caller/row guards; stored status fields with explicit completion copying are also already expressible. No approach may implicitly declassify a derive, grant a directory, reinterpret withheld as null, or claim executed privacy tests. Compare implementable draft contracts, not current tool capability.

disclosure.instructions: Which alternative best satisfies the stated disclosure and workflow outcomes with a coherent draft contract?

criteria.leaf_grants: Define explicit selectors such as notification.status for embedded-value/receipt leaves, excluding traversal through model references. Grant only selected leaves and null traversal presence; a grant to notice_state alone remains insufficient. Record-field provenance, property checks, withholding and revision fences must be specified in JS lookup and serialization. Keep the computed column and transport-owned progression; this adds leaf-permission semantics and checker/runtime obligations without stored copying.
criteria.authority_read: Keep existing whole-field permissions. Add one scope=authority read returning only a nullable typed status, with authenticated admission and explicit current recipient-or-staff row guards. Render its authorized result through the existing read form and expose that same read to MCP. This retains current disclosure mechanisms but adds an operation/result schema and changes the inline table interaction; all guards must remain consistent.
criteria.status_mirror: Keep recipient status as an ordinary separately granted stored field. On enqueue set pending and correlate explicit completion by current notification.id before copying status; retain explicit notified business transition. Existing field permissions and table display apply. Additional app bookkeeping and domain row versions/history occur on receipt updates, and statuses depend on callback processing rather than direct receipt observation.
